record.bible_text: Then Joseph<WH03130> could<WH03201><WTH8804> not refrain<WH0662><WTH8692> himself before all them that stood<WH05324><WTH8737> by him; and he cried<WH07121><WTH8799>, Cause<WH03318><WH00> every man<WH0376> to go out<WH03318><WTH8685> from me. And there stood<WH05975><WTH8804> no man<WH0376> with him, while Joseph<WH03130> made himself known<WH03045><WTH8692> unto his brethren<WH0251>.

And he wept<WH06963><WH01065> aloud<WH05414><WTH8799>: and the Egyptians<WH04714> and the house<WH01004> of Pharaoh<WH06547> heard<WH08085><WTH8799><WH08085><WTH8799>. <RF>wept...: Heb. gave forth his voice in weeping<Rf>

And Joseph<WH03130> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto his brethren<WH0251>, I <FI>am<Fi> Joseph<WH03130>; doth my father<WH01> yet live<WH02416>? And his brethren<WH0251> could<WH03201><WTH8804> not answer<WH06030><WTH8800> him; for they were troubled<WH0926><WTH8738> at his presence<WH06440>. <RF>troubled: or, terrified<Rf>

And Joseph<WH03130> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto his brethren<WH0251>, Come near<WH05066><WTH8798> to me, I pray you. And they came near<WH05066><WTH8799>. And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, I <FI>am<Fi> Joseph<WH03130> your brother<WH0251>, whom ye sold<WH04376><WTH8804> into Egypt<WH04714>.

Now therefore be not grieved<WH06087><WTH8735>, nor angry<WH02734><WTH8799> with yourselves<WH05869>, that ye sold<WH04376><WTH8804> me hither: for God<WH0430> did send<WH07971><WTH8804> me before you<WH06440> to preserve life<WH04241>. <RF>nor...: Heb. neither let there be anger in your eyes<Rf>

For these two years<WH08141> <FI>hath<Fi> the famine<WH07458> <FI>been<Fi> in<WH07130> the land<WH0776>: and yet <FI>there are<Fi> five<WH02568> years<WH08141>, in the which <FI>there shall<Fi> neither<WH0369> <FI>be<Fi> earing<WH02758> nor harvest<WH07105>.

And God<WH0430> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> me before you<WH06440> to preserve<WH07760><WTH8800> you a posterity<WH07611> in the earth<WH0776>, and to save your lives<WH02421><WTH8687> by a great<WH01419> deliverance<WH06413>. <RF>to preserve...: Heb. to put for you a remnant<Rf>

So now <FI>it was<Fi> not you <FI>that<Fi> sent<WH07971><WTH8804> me hither, but God<WH0430>: and he hath made<WH07760><WTH8799> me a father<WH01> to Pharaoh<WH06547>, and lord<WH0113> of all his house<WH01004>, and a ruler<WH04910><WTH8802> throughout all the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>.

Haste<WH04116><WTH8761> ye, and go up<WH05927><WTH8798> to my father<WH01>, and say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto him, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> thy son<WH01121> Joseph<WH03130>, God<WH0430> hath made<WH07760><WTH8804> me lord<WH0113> of all Egypt<WH04714>: come down<WH03381><WTH8798> unto me, tarry<WH05975><WTH8799> not:

And thou shalt dwell<WH03427><WTH8804> in the land<WH0776> of Goshen<WH01657>, and thou shalt be near<WH07138> unto me, thou, and thy children<WH01121>, and thy children's<WH01121> children<WH01121>, and thy flocks<WH06629>, and thy herds<WH01241>, and all that thou hast:

And there will I nourish<WH03557><WTH8773> thee; for yet <FI>there are<Fi> five<WH02568> years<WH08141> of famine<WH07458>; lest thou, and thy household<WH01004>, and all that thou hast, come to poverty<WH03423><WTH8735>.
And, behold, your eyes<WH05869> see<WH07200><WTH8802>, and the eyes<WH05869> of my brother<WH0251> Benjamin<WH01144>, that <FI>it is<Fi> my mouth<WH06310> that speaketh<WH01696><WTH8764> unto you.

And ye shall tell<WH05046><WTH8689> my father<WH01> of all my glory<WH03519> in Egypt<WH04714>, and of all that ye have seen<WH07200><WTH8804>; and ye shall haste<WH04116><WTH8765> and bring down<WH03381><WTH8689> my father<WH01> hither.
And he fell<WH05307><WTH8799> upon his brother<WH0251> Benjamin's<WH01144> neck<WH06677>, and wept<WH01058><WTH8799>; and Benjamin<WH01144> wept<WH01058><WTH8804> upon his neck<WH06677>.
Moreover he kissed<WH05401><WTH8762> all his brethren<WH0251>, and wept<WH01058><WTH8799> upon them: and after<WH0310> that his brethren<WH0251> talked<WH01696><WTH8765> with him.<CM>

And the fame<WH06963> thereof was heard<WH08085><WTH8738> in Pharaoh's<WH06547> house<WH01004>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Joseph's<WH03130> brethren<WH0251> are come<WH0935><WTH8804>: and it pleased<WH03190><WH00><WH05869><WH00> Pharaoh<WH06547> well<WH03190><WTH8799><WH05869>, and<WH05869> his servants<WH05650>. <RF>pleased...: Heb. was good in the eyes of Pharaoh<Rf>

And Pharaoh<WH06547> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Joseph<WH03130>, Say<WH0559><WTH8798> unto thy brethren<WH0251>, This do<WH06213><WTH8798> ye; lade<WH02943><WTH8798> your beasts<WH01165>, and go<WH03212><WTH8798>, get<WH0935><WTH8798> you unto the land<WH0776> of Canaan<WH03667>;

And take<WH03947><WTH8798> your father<WH01> and your households<WH01004>, and come<WH0935><WTH8798> unto me: and I will give<WH05414><WTH8799> you the good<WH02898> of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>, and ye shall eat<WH0398><WTH8798> the fat<WH02459> of the land<WH0776>.

Now thou art commanded<WH06680><WTH8795>, this do<WH06213><WTH8798> ye; take<WH03947><WTH8798> you wagons<WH05699> out of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714> for your little ones<WH02945>, and for your wives<WH0802>, and bring<WH05375><WTH8804> your father<WH01>, and come<WH0935><WTH8804>.
Also<WH05869> regard<WH02347><WTH8799> not your stuff<WH03627>; for the good<WH02898> of all the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714> <FI>is<Fi> yours. <RF>regard...: Heb. let not your eye spare, etc.<Rf>

And the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> did<WH06213><WTH8799> so: and Joseph<WH03130> gave<WH05414><WTH8799> them wagons<WH05699>, according to the commandment<WH06310> of Pharaoh<WH06547>, and gave<WH05414><WTH8799> them provision<WH06720> for the way<WH01870>. <RF>commandment: Heb. mouth<Rf>

To all of them he gave<WH05414><WTH8804> each man<WH0376> changes<WH02487> of raiment<WH08071>; but to Benjamin<WH01144> he gave<WH05414><WTH8804> three<WH07969> hundred<WH03967> <FI>pieces<Fi> of silver<WH03701>, and five<WH02568> changes<WH02487> of raiment<WH08071>.

And to his father<WH01> he sent<WH07971><WTH8804> after this<WH02063> <FI>manner<Fi> ; ten<WH06235> asses<WH0860> laden<WH05375><WTH8802> with the good things<WH02898> of Egypt<WH04714>, and ten<WH06235> she asses<WH02543> laden<WH05375><WTH8802> with corn<WH01250> and bread<WH03899> and meat<WH04202> for his father<WH01> by the way<WH01870>. <RF>laden...: Heb. carrying<Rf>

So he sent<WH07971><WH00> his brethren<WH0251> away<WH07971><WTH8762>, and they departed<WH03212><WTH8799>: and he said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto them, See that ye fall not out<WH07264><WTH8799> by the way<WH01870>.<CM>
And they went up<WH05927><WTH8799> out of Egypt<WH04714>, and came<WH0935><WTH8799> into the land<WH0776> of Canaan<WH03667> unto Jacob<WH03290> their father<WH01>,

And told<WH05046><WTH8686> him, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Joseph<WH03130> <FI>is<Fi> yet alive<WH02416>, and he <FI>is<Fi> governor<WH04910><WTH8802> over all the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>. And Jacob's heart<WH03820> fainted<WH06313><WTH8799>, for he believed<WH0539><WTH8689> them not. <RF>Jacob's: Heb. his<Rf>

And they told<WH01696><WTH8762> him all the words<WH01697> of Joseph<WH03130>, which he had said<WH01696><WTH8765> unto them: and when he saw<WH07200><WTH8799> the wagons<WH05699> which Joseph<WH03130> had sent<WH07971><WTH8804> to carry<WH05375><WTH8800> him, the spirit<WH07307> of Jacob<WH03290> their father<WH01> revived<WH02421><WTH8799>:

And Israel<WH03478> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>It is<Fi> enough<WH07227>; Joseph<WH03130> my son<WH01121> <FI>is<Fi> yet alive<WH02416>: I will go<WH03212><WTH8799> and see him<WH07200><WTH8799> before I die<WH04191><WTH8799>.<CM>
